d: Five near-Earth asteroids are making close approaches to our planet over November 19 and 20. NASA's tracking systems have calculated their trajectories, and none is expected to hit Earth. But these flybys highlight a much bigger question: how vulnerable is our planet to an asteroid impact? More than 40,000 near-Earth asteroids have been discovered. Some are large enough to cause regional destruction if they ever collide with Earth. From the 2013 Chelyabinsk explosion to NASA's planetary-defence missions, we examine the space rocks that could threaten our planet and how scientists are…
